reason: Avoid presenting sparse classified intervals as a whole-night total; tolerate bounded, recorded short weak-signal intervals.
processing: On-device only; same envelope features and physiological limitations as v1.

changes.shortWeakSignal: Bridge at most 3 contiguous recorded 30-second quiet epochs bounded on both sides by respiratory evidence; reject speech, capture gaps and invalid levels.
changes.stageSafeguard: Bridged epochs do not count toward stable/variable evidence for deep/REM hypotheses.
changes.total: Expose a whole-night sleep estimate only when at least 90% of in-bed time has classified intervals. Otherwise show partial evidence, not a misleading whole-night duration.
changes.historical: Recompute from retained v1/v2 numeric features. Cannot reconstruct missing observations or recover deleted audio.

limits: No extrapolation through capture gaps or long unsupported intervals.
May confuse awake breathing, companions or rhythmic noise.
Synthetic regression tests verify logic, not real-night accuracy.
